stop_rule: Stop after the 24 published integers, the two positive controls, the structural facts, the tie-out, the sensitivity envelope, and the four mutation controls. Do not assign a stock coefficient, do not re-derive cutoffs from the frozen assembler, do not touch the complex supplier.
